entities.name: HisH (A9WQ58)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A9WQ58 from Renibacterium salmoninarum; 219 aa, predicted mass 23.47 kDa.
HisH glutaminase subunit of imidazole glycerol phosphate synthase (IGPS); hydrolyzes glutamine to glutamate and ammonia for ammonia transfer to HisF.
IGPS participates in L-histidine biosynthesis; reference annotation places protein in cytoplasm and describes a HisH-HisF heterodimer.
Pfam detects glutamine amidotransferase family domains GATase PF00117 (residues 7–206) and GATase_3 PF07685 (residues 19–117).
Sequence-derived pI 5.33, instability index 23.03, and GRAVY -0.018; estimates do not account for modifications or assembly.
